result.reason: The clause substantially tracks the preferred position by adding a mutual USD 1 million/12-month cap and the required uncapped claims. However, the cap uses all “amounts paid or payable between the parties” rather than fees and measures the lookback from the event giving rise to the claim rather than from the claim. More importantly, it exempts amounts owed by either party under Section 5, whereas the playbook only requires Customer payment obligations to be treated as outside the damages cap; this unnecessarily alters the other party’s payment exposure. It also does not expressly state that Customer payment obligations are not damages. The drafting is generally professional but includes these ambiguities and retains the punctuation error in subsection (a).
